Results-driven professional with 25+ years of experience in practical medicine, teaching, clinical research, pharmaceutical industry. I possess a robust clinical background complemented by expertise in clinical trial management, medical advising and medical project management, scientific leadership and medical teams management, pharmacovigilance, quality assurance and compliance.
As an MD certified in Pediatrics and Gastroenterology, I have treated children and adults with GE pathologies, including Inflammatory Bowel Diseases, Ulcer Disease, Gastroesophageal Reflux Disease, Coeliac Disease, Pancreas and Liver Diseases, including rare metabolic (orphan) diseases.
3 years spent as a Clinical Research Associate at a Global Research Organisation let me gain valuable insights into various aspects of drug development.
During my tenure as a Medical Advisor/ Medical Manager/ Head of MSLs at pharmaceutical companies I’ve got comprehensive understanding of the medical function in pharmaceutical industry and significant experience in medical strategy development and implementation for pre-registration, newly registered and mature products in various therapeutic areas (GE, CV, Diabetes, Nephrology, Women’s Health, Surgery, Hematology, Orphan Diseases, etc.).
